name: conflicting_memory
description: Measures retrieval when an older recommendation conflicts with the current decision.

memories.title: Use JSON for persistent agent memory
memories.content: JSON is the recommended persistent backend because it is easy to inspect and copy.

memories.title: Use SQLite for persistent agent memory
memories.content: SQLite is the recommended persistent backend. It provides WAL mode and BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions; JSON remains for demos.

memories.title: Event log is the source of truth
memories.content: Nodes, edges, and trees are rebuildable materialized state. The append-only event log is the semantic source of truth.

memories.title: SQLite schema version two
memories.content: Schema v2 added owner, scope, confidence, familiarity, folded_into, and event_log fields.

cases.query: Which backend is currently recommended for persistent agent memory?
What is the source of truth and which state can be rebuilt?
